changelog:
- Initial release of seo-optimizer-cn (v1.0.0)
- Optimizes content for Chinese social media SEO: titles, keyword density, hashtags
- Scans for advertising-law banned words (广告法违禁词) ensuring compliance
- Provides keyword analysis, tailored title and body recommendations, and hashtag suggestions
- Supports activation on relevant SEO and compliance check triggers
- Outputs structured optimization and compliance reports
summary: SEO optimizer and compliance checker for Chinese social media. Optimizes titles, keyword density, hashtags, and scans for advertising-law banned words (广告法违禁词).
